title: BT disconnect with medtrum, unable to reconnect
body:
I noticed on ~16:10 that my medtrum nano 300 was not reachable for 78 min. 
So reducing back: It should have started arround 14:50
It stayed in the "connecting" phase, aka the spinning BT icon on the BLE Status label..

I'm not sure what went wrong, but it tends to happen when i had a connection for a certain period of time to an audio device (Android Auto, sometimes my BT headphones). 
Thats the only somewhat consistent thing i seem to find: when one of the 2 devices disconnects, after some time the connection to the pump stops. Not sure if the connection to the CGM stops as well. I think it also stops, will have to keep track next time.
This sometimes happens, its not reproducable in any consistent way.

After I reboot my phone this issue goes away.

I did an export after the reboot, so i'll try to attach the logs (one that came from the the maintance page, the other from the preffered path).

**Phone info**
- OnePlus 12R 
Version CPH2609_16.0.5.702 (EX01)
Android 16
- Bootloader unlocked + rooted.
- Disabled Play Store protection
- AAPS & BYODA are locked (OnePlus thing i believe)
- AAPS & BYODA have "allow background usage", disabled "Manage app if unused" and all permissions they asked for.
- BT has no battery limitations i could find.

**AAPS version**
3.4.2.3 (05a3)

**Pump info**:
Medtrum nano 300
FW: 1.81.78
Active for ~2.5 days.

**Other**
- Nightscout enabled
- BYODA - G7 sensor - active for ~3 days - Just moved over from xdrip+
- No other car apps that require BT

It also happened when I was using xdrip+ sometimes

In case any other info is needed, let me know.
If I have a repeat i'll add it here.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1783519409330.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29812499/AndroidAPS_LOG_1783519409330.log.zip)
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29812500/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body: This is Android BLE implementation stack issue. Change phone or don't use other BLE devices (which could help a bit)
